instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a couple in a snowy forest. On the right, the woman in the grey beanie (R1) stands in a black leather jacket, holding a black dog and looking down peacefully with closed eyes. On the left, the man in the brown coat (R2), wearing a black beanie, leans in to kiss the dog's head. They stand close together on a snow-covered path, sharing a quiet moment. Soft, diffused winter daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the cool tones of the snow and the warm tones of their winter clothing.
